manualReason: ImageJ 1.x releases use letter suffixes (for example 1.54t) that the shared numeric release parser does not accept. Check the first entry of https://wsr.imagej.net/jars/list.txt (the release list read by Help > Update ImageJ) and the release notes; ignore daily builds such as 1.54u8.
scope: Qualified ImageJ 1.54t ij.jar (headless, fixed Java source program on public ImageJ 1.x API, OpenJDK 21, Linux x86-64, serial): one 8/16-bit unsigned grayscale PGM/TIFF plane, inclusive manual raw threshold, eight/four connectivity (four with holes), hole filling, edge exclusion, whole-pixel area window, declared nm/um/mm/cm/m calibration with rectangular pixels; area, centroid, bounds and raw mean/min/max independently verified against a connected-component model, native count mask and fresh-process ImageStatistics readback on synthetic analytic targets; Calc table handoff and reuse. No automatic thresholds, shape descriptors, colour/stacks, Fiji launcher/plugins, R consumer or other ImageJ releases.
acceptance: Run tools/qualify_imagej_fixtures.py --check and tools/qualify_imagej.py with the target ij.jar and a Java 11+ runtime (plus Calc for the handoff); require all analytic synthetic-target cases, native kit tamper/timeout/cancellation probes and the Calc table readback.
